fields.label: BOM Line
fields.description: Matches Style BOM Item.line_id. Pick the line this override applies to.

fields.label: Colourway Code
fields.description: Blank = applies to all colourways for this line.

fields.label: Size Code
fields.description: Blank = applies to all sizes for this line.

fields.label: Override Item
fields.description: Leave blank unless this exact colourway/size combination needs a different material than auto-resolution would pick.

fields.label: Override Consumption
fields.description: Leave blank to use the line's Base Qty.

fields.label: Note
fields.description: Why this exception exists, e.g. 'Maroon uses Black rib, not auto-matched Maroon rib'.
